meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Agent sources and chat JSON behavior are unchanged. Shared backend developer reference now explains mail events and recipient boundaries without granting an agent send/payment/password capability; rechecked existing role-tool and transcript requirements remain intact.

auth.review_note: Cross-checked manual registration, new Google callback identity match and password-reset/profile CAS success paths. New verified Google customers get stable signup welcome, not returning accounts/admins; successful profile password change uses customer security template after CAS. Denied/stale paths do not notify, no credentials/scopes/roles or database configuration changed.

commerce.review_note: Commerce order creation, gateway verification, tax/invoice issuance and OrderService are unchanged. Rechecked finalizeOrder calls confirmation only on newly persisted verified order; templates read saved amounts and issued invoice number without mutation. Shared backend docs now explicitly distinguish synthetic email tests from live financial acceptance.

content.review_note: Four reproduced defects and timezone/CAS fixtures now pass. BlogService compares expected SHA under a lock and atomic rename; direct/public list/agent/sitemap visibility is unified; six-worker test permits one writer only. Two isolated browser editor workflows prove stale save/delete rejection, preserved rejected text and reload/current revision at 1280px/375px without live content mutation.

foundation.review_note: Existing admin authentication and controller routing are reused; new POST cannot bypass CSRF, audience/key/token checks or queue claim semantics. Account mutation/send separation and private preview boundaries checked against existing architecture. No DB schema/connection/SecretService change and unrelated late-view HTTP error issue remains separately tracked.

google-tags.review_note: Read the original unused client and duplicate inline public rendering plus official current Google ID/config/verification docs. One validating HTML/JSON-encoding client now drives actual public rendering and independent owner statuses. Four fail-first regressions and an isolated browser fixture prove hostile values are omitted while valid existing G/GT/AW outputs remain. No external collection/ownership claim.

interface.review_note: Reviewed actual Templates selector/trigger/audience views, scripts-disabled srcdoc preview, real CSRF field, disabled wrong-role input and one-shot confirmation flow. Three Playwright suites pass at desktop/375px/no-JS with no send; actual logo decodes and no horizontal overflow. Preview uses real renderer but synthetic evidence, not fake customer results.

mail.review_note: Actual Gmail MIME exposed style text and lost link targets in strip_tags fallback. Replaced only text extraction with PHP8.3 DOM traversal excluding style/script/head/hidden content, preserving UTF8, block/table separation and safe URLs. Exact MIME regression preserves unchanged HTML and headers; loopback transport semantics unchanged. This is text extraction, not HTML sanitation or delivery approval.

media.review_note: Media sources and storage/delete behavior are unchanged. Shared admin-UI skill gained only sandboxed email preview acceptance guidance; inspected the existing media guard contract to ensure no delete/asset permission changed. Mail logo decode is checked without changing media.

operator-help.review_note: Compared the new native plain-text disclosure with the same SmtpMailer projection used for MIME. Guide explains CSS removal, preserved visible warnings and safe links without claiming a new send or arbitrary CSS rendering; existing admin authorization and recipient split are unchanged.

sales-channels.review_note: Reviewed service/XML/CLI/UI against ProductService offer and visibility behavior plus current primary Google product-source and invited-creator docs. Verified explicit identifiers only, valid URL/image checks, safe XML, unknown external approval and no credential/account actions. Public browser samples match real prices/images; local missing media is not labelled a production defect.

workflow.review_note: Added actual template/auth source dependencies and route/service references; concrete work status stays in GitHub #287/#25, not issue-ledger docs. Developer references describe event/recipient/evidence boundaries. Generated indexes will be regenerated and source-doc hashes are explicit review receipts, not auto-certification.
